summary: Initializes and runs the OSC script engine. Guards on the script-data object parameter a2 (returns -1 when null), copies the script name out of a2's vtable (entry +12) into this+0xC, stores the parser flags a3/a4 into this+0x198/0x199, clears this+0x19A to 0, stores the script-data pointer into this+0x1A4, and opens the file streams via FileOpenWrapperWithModeCheck. On success it runs the parser sub_4920B0, and when the byte_5CC2CC flag is set builds paths (base from dword_5EC418 with byte_5EA438 fallback) to load eas.bik and eaintro.bik videos plus the legal.bmp resource, feeds the script object to sub_496380, runs the parser sub_492160, performs TripleFieldCleanup, clears byte_5CC2CC and calls FunctionCallWrapper_b970.

local_names.a2: script-data object; supplies the script name and is stored at this+0x1A4
local_names.v10: stack buffer holding the built media file path string
local_names.v9: return value of the parser run sub_492160

operations.description: When the script-data object a2 is null, return -1 immediately without touching any fields
Call a2's vtable entry +12 and strcpy the returned script-name string into this+0xC
Store parser flag a3 into this+0x198 and a4 into this+0x199; clear this+0x19A to literal 0; store the script-data pointer a2 into this+0x1A4
Open the file streams on this via FileOpenWrapperWithModeCheck; the remainder of the function only runs when it does not return -1
Run the parser sub_4920B0 on this after the file streams are open
When the byte_5CC2CC flag is set, perform the media loading block
Path base is dword_5EC418, falling back to byte_5EA438 when dword_5EC418 is null
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck builds "%s%s" from the path base and aEasBik; FileLoadWithRetryLoop loads the resulting eas.bik file with index 0
ResourceFileLoader loads the legal.bmp resource (aLegalBmp) with scale 3.0 and index 0
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck builds "%s%s" from the path base and aEaintroBik; FileLoadWithRetryLoop loads the resulting eaintro.bik file with index 1
Feed the script-data object a2 into sub_496380
Run the script parser sub_492160 on this; its result becomes the function return value on the success path
TripleFieldCleanup tears down the opened streams/fields of this
When byte_5CC2CC is set, clear it to 0 and call FunctionCallWrapper_b970
Return the parser result (v9) on success, or the FileOpenWrapperWithModeCheck result when it failed; called by sub_485B90 (00485B90)
